commands.title: Conformance · toml-test Runner
commands.run: command -v go > /dev/null || brew install --quiet go; T="$PWD/.build/toml-test" && (cd .build/fixtures/toml-test && go build -o "$T" ./cmd/toml-test) && swift build -c release --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter && A="$(swift build -c release --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter --show-bin-path)/toml-test-adapter" && for v in 1.0 1.1; do "$T" test -toml "$v" -decoder "$A decode $v" -encoder "$A encode" -color never || exit 1; done

commands.title: Conformance · editorconfig-core-test
commands.run: swift build -c release --package-path Tools/EditorConfigAdapter --scratch-path .build/editorconfig-adapter && A="$(swift build -c release --package-path Tools/EditorConfigAdapter --scratch-path .build/editorconfig-adapter --show-bin-path)/editorconfig" && cmake -S .build/fixtures/editorconfig-core-test -B .build/editorconfig-core-test -DEDITORCONFIG_CMD="$A" > /dev/null && ctest --test-dir .build/editorconfig-core-test --output-on-failure -j 4

commands.title: Verification · toml++ Differential
commands.run: (brew list tomlplusplus > /dev/null 2>&1 || brew install --quiet tomlplusplus) && clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -w -I"$(brew --prefix)/include" Benchmarks/References/toml_tagged.cpp -o .build/tomlpp-decoder && swift test --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter-tests && swift build -c release --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter && A="$(swift build -c release --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter --show-bin-path)/toml-test-adapter" && "$A" differential .build/tomlpp-decoder --mutations 10 --known Tools/TOMLTestAdapter/Differential/known.txt .build/fixtures/toml-test/tests .build/fixtures/corpus Tools/TOMLTestAdapter/Differential/inputs

commands.title: Performance · Benchmarks against the Commit Before
Verification · libFuzzer (YAML, TOML, EditorConfig)
commands.run: .ci/swift-ci run suites && swift build -c release --package-path Tools/Fuzz --scratch-path .build/fuzz -Xswiftc -sanitize=fuzzer,address -Xswiftc -parse-as-library && mkdir -p .build/fuzz-corpus/yaml .build/fuzz-corpus/toml && find .build/fixtures/yaml-test-suite .build/fixtures/corpus -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) -size -32k -exec cp --backup=numbered -t .build/fuzz-corpus/yaml {} + && find .build/fixtures/toml-test/tests .build/fixtures/corpus -type f -name '*.toml' -size -32k -exec cp --backup=numbered -t .build/fuzz-corpus/toml {} + && .build/fuzz/release/FuzzYAML -max_total_time=900 -timeout=5 -rss_limit_mb=2048 -max_len=8192 .build/fuzz-corpus/yaml && .build/fuzz/release/FuzzTOML -max_total_time=900 -timeout=5 -rss_limit_mb=2048 -max_len=8192 .build/fuzz-corpus/toml && mkdir -p .build/fuzz-corpus/editorconfig && cp .build/fixtures/editorconfig-core-test/*/*.in .build/fuzz-corpus/editorconfig/ && .build/fuzz/release/FuzzEditorConfig -max_total_time=300 -timeout=5 -rss_limit_mb=2048 -max_len=4096 .build/fuzz-corpus/editorconfig
